title: plugin-chatbot / app-shell: an assistant answer's chart is gone after a reload — no hydration path keeps `data-chart` parts
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 4 from an out-of-scope finding on objectui#13492 (dev report `6393359237`, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13500). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route. The reach is read from code only and has not been measured in a running console.

## Reading (source, `main` at the time of objectui#13492)

objectui#13492 makes an assistant answer render its charts in stream order. After a reload, though, no objectui path restores the chart at all, so the chart is missing, not misplaced:

- The server persists a conversation turn as a `ModelMessage` (spec `contracts/ai-service.ts`, `IAIConversationService.addMessage`), which carries no data parts.
- app-shell's `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` builds `content` and tool invocations only.
- `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache` writes text and tool parts only.

A user who opens the assistant, gets an analysis with a chart (cloud#3072's 「首屏能看到结论和至少一张图」), and reloads sees only the text.

## Ask

Decide where the chart should survive a reload. Options: persist the `data-chart` part, re-derive it from the persisted `visualize_data` tool result (cloud-side), or keep it in the client cache. Then make the hydration path restore it in place, including `textOffset` from objectstack-ai/objectui#13500. Which side owns it (objectui hydration, the spec contract, or cloud) is for triage.

Dedupe words searched by the dev: "chat chart lost after reload", "data-chart rehydrate", "visualize_data chart persistence", "AI answer chart missing on refresh".
